title: ADR-NNNN: Decision Title
html:
Status: proposed Date: YYYY-MM-DD

Context

Describe the architectural problem or constraint that requires a decision.

Include only the context necessary to understand:

  • why a decision is needed;
  • which systems or boundaries are affected;
  • which constraints materially influence the choice;
  • which assumptions matter.

Avoid turning this section into a complete implementation design.

Decision

State the architectural decision clearly.

This section should make it possible to understand the chosen direction without inferring it from the alternatives or rationale.

Example form:

This repository will ...

Rationale

Explain why this option was selected.

Focus on the tradeoffs, constraints, and evidence that materially influenced the decision.

Do not list only advantages.

Alternatives Considered

Alternative A

Briefly describe the alternative and why it was not selected.

Alternative B

Briefly describe the alternative and why it was not selected.

Remove unused alternative sections rather than inventing alternatives.

Consequences

Positive

  • Describe meaningful benefits.

Negative

  • Describe accepted costs, limitations, or additional responsibilities.

Operational or Migration Impact

  • Describe important deployment, compatibility, data, security, or migration consequences when applicable.

Remove this subsection when there is no meaningful operational or migration impact.

References

Include only useful references.

Link relevant current policies, related ADRs, design documents, and evidence. Use actual relative Markdown links to existing records; remove unused references.

If this ADR supersedes another accepted ADR, update that ADR to reference this one as its replacement.
